claim: Amazon RDS runs a fully managed relational database and offloads database administration; a relational database AMI on Amazon EC2 means you manage your own relational database.
question: When would you use Amazon RDS instead of a relational database AMI on Amazon EC2?

evidence.quote: Amazon RDS enables you to run a fully managed and fully featured relational database while offloading database administration. Using one of our many relational database AMIs on Amazon EC2 allows you to manage your own relational database in the cloud.

claim: Amazon RDS gives you RDS for PostgreSQL, RDS for MySQL, RDS for MariaDB, RDS for SQL Server, RDS for Oracle, or RDS for Db2.
question: Which database engines does Amazon RDS offer?

values.display: RDS for Oracle, or RDS for Db2

evidence.quote: Amazon RDS gives you access to the capabilities of a familiar RDS for PostgreSQL, RDS for MySQL, RDS for MariaDB, RDS for SQL Server, RDS for Oracle, or RDS for Db2 database.

claim: Amazon RDS can automatically back up your database and keep the database software up to date.
question: Which administration tasks does Amazon RDS do for you?

evidence.quote: Amazon RDS can automatically back up your database and keep your database software up to date with the latest version.

claim: By default, an account can have up to 40 DB instances in total.
question: By default, how many Amazon RDS DB instances can an account run?

qualifiers.scope: per account, all RDS DB instances in total

evidence.quote: By default, customers are allowed to have up to a total of 40 Amazon RDS DB instances.
You can purchase up to 40 reserved DB instances. If you wish to run more than 40 DB instances, please complete the Amazon RDS DB Instance request form.

note: Adjustable: the FAQ points to a request form for more than 40. Same value as rds-quota-db-instances (numbers lens).

claim: Of the default 40 DB instances, up to 10 can be RDS for Oracle or RDS for SQL Server DB instances under the License Included model.
question: How many of the default RDS DB instances can be Oracle or SQL Server with License Included?

qualifiers.scope: per account, RDS for Oracle or RDS for SQL Server DB instances under the License Included model

evidence.quote: Of those 40, up to 10 can be RDS for Oracle or RDS for SQL Server DB instances under the "License Included" model.

claim: An RDS for SQL Server DB instance holds up to 100 databases.
question: How many databases can one RDS for SQL Server DB instance hold?

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance, RDS for SQL Server

evidence.quote: RDS for SQL Server: Up to 100 databases per instance

claim: An RDS for Oracle DB instance holds 1 database, with no software limit on the number of schemas per database.
question: How many databases can one RDS for Oracle DB instance hold?

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance, RDS for Oracle

evidence.quote: RDS for Oracle: 1 database per instance; no limit on the number of schemas per database imposed by software

claim: If you do not choose a preferred weekly maintenance window when you create a DB instance, RDS assigns a 30-minute default window.
question: What maintenance window does RDS assign if you do not specify one?

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance, preferred weekly maintenance window

evidence.quote: If you do not specify a preferred weekly maintenance window when creating your DB instance, a 30-minute default value is assigned.

claim: The maintenance window controls when DB instance modifications, engine version upgrades and software patching happen; a scheduled maintenance event starts during that window.
question: What is the RDS maintenance window?

values.display: initiated during the maintenance window you identify

evidence.quote: The Amazon RDS maintenance window is your opportunity to control when DB instance modifications, database engine version upgrades, and software patching occurs, in the event they are requested or required. If a maintenance event is scheduled for a given week, it will be initiated during the maintenance window you identify.

claim: The maintenance events that take a DB instance offline are compute scaling (generally a few minutes), database engine version upgrades and required software patching.
question: Which maintenance events take an RDS DB instance offline?

evidence.quote: Maintenance events that require Amazon RDS to take your DB instance offline are scale compute operations (which generally take only a few minutes from start-to-finish), database engine version upgrades, and required software patching.

claim: RDS schedules required software patching automatically only for patches that are security and durability related.
question: Which patches does RDS schedule automatically as required patching?

evidence.quote: Required software patching is automatically scheduled only for patches that are security and durability related.

claim: Running a DB instance as a Multi-AZ deployment can further reduce the impact of a maintenance event.
question: How can you reduce the impact of RDS maintenance on availability?

values.display: further reduce the impact of a maintenance event

evidence.quote: Running your DB instance as a Multi-AZ deployment can further reduce the impact of a maintenance event.

claim: By default, a manual engine version upgrade is applied during the next maintenance window; you can choose Apply Immediately to upgrade at once.
question: When is a manual RDS engine version upgrade applied by default?

qualifiers.scope: manual engine version upgrade of a DB instance

evidence.quote: By default, the upgrade will be applied during your next maintenance window. You can also choose to upgrade immediately by selecting the Apply Immediately option in the console API.

claim: Upgrading a DB engine version requires downtime, even for Multi-AZ instances.
question: Does a Multi-AZ RDS DB instance avoid downtime during an engine version upgrade?

evidence.quote: We schedule them so you can plan around them because downtime is required to upgrade a DB engine version, even for Multi-AZ instances.

claim: When a new minor engine version has significant bug fixes, RDS schedules automatic upgrades for DB instances whose Auto Minor Version Upgrade setting is Yes.
question: Which RDS DB instances get automatic minor version upgrades?

evidence.quote: If we determine that a new engine minor version contains significant bug fixes compared to a previously released minor version, we will schedule automatic upgrades for DB instances that have the Auto Minor Version Upgrade setting to “Yes”.

claim: Major version upgrades do not happen automatically and must be started by you, except when the major version is deprecated.
question: Does RDS apply major engine version upgrades automatically?

evidence.quote: Since major version upgrades involve some compatibility risk, they will not occur automatically and must be initiated by you (except in the case of major version deprecation, see below).

claim: To test a new engine version, create a DB snapshot, restore it to a new DB instance, and upgrade that new instance first.
question: How can you test an RDS engine upgrade before upgrading the production DB instance?

values.display: initiating a version upgrade for the new DB instance

evidence.quote: You can do so by creating a DB snapshot of your existing DB instance, restoring from the DB snapshot to create a new DB instance, and then initiating a version upgrade for the new DB instance.

claim: After RDS announces that a minor engine version is deprecated, there is a three (3) month period before automatic upgrades begin.
question: How long after a minor engine version deprecation is announced does RDS start automatic upgrades?

evidence.quote: When a minor version of a database engine is deprecated in Amazon RDS, we will provide a three (3) month period after the announcement before beginning automatic upgrades.

claim: After RDS announces that a major engine version is deprecated, you get a minimum six (6) month period to start an upgrade yourself.
question: How long do you have to upgrade after RDS announces a major engine version deprecation?

evidence.quote: When a major version of the database engine is deprecated in Amazon RDS, we will provide a minimum six (6) month period after the announcement of a deprecation for you to initiate an upgrade to a supported major version.

claim: A DB parameter group is a container for engine configuration values that can be applied to one or more DB instances.
question: What is an RDS DB parameter group?

evidence.quote: A database parameter group (DB Parameter Group) acts as a “container” for engine configuration values that can be applied to one or more DB Instances.

claim: If you create a DB instance without specifying a DB parameter group, a default DB parameter group is used.
question: Which parameter group does an RDS DB instance use if you do not specify one?

values.display: a default DB Parameter Group is used

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance created without a DB parameter group

evidence.quote: If you create a DB Instance without specifying a DB Parameter Group, a default DB Parameter Group is used.

claim: All DB instances that use a DB parameter group get every parameter update made to that group.
question: What happens to DB instances when you change a DB parameter group they use?

evidence.quote: Once associated, all DB Instances that use a particular DB Parameter Group get all the parameter updates to that DB Parameter Group.
